collection.name: Software & Bots
collection.description: Application runtimes, Discord bots, APIs and microservices
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Python
shard.description: General-purpose Python 3 environment supporting Git auto-pull, requirements.txt dependency installation, and Discord bots or Flask/FastAPI services.
shard.author: Midnight Team
shard.startupCommand: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{GIT_AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ -f requirements.txt ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; fi; python3 {{MAIN_FILE}} {{ADDITIONAL_ARGS}}
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Python Application Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache git curl ca-certificates build-base

cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning git repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        GIT_BRANCH="main"
    fi
    git clone -b ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
    echo "Found requirements.txt, installing Python packages..."
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
fi

echo "Python application installation completed!"

variables.name: Main Executable Script
variables.description: The entrypoint Python file to execute (e.g. main.py, bot.py, app.py).

variables.name: Auto Update Dependencies
variables.description: Automatically run 'pip install -r requirements.txt' on server startup (1 = yes, 0 = no).

variables.name: Git Auto Pull
variables.description: Automatically run 'git pull' on server startup (1 = yes, 0 = no).

variables.name: Git Clone Address
variables.description: Optional Git repository URL to clone upon server creation.
